company_report.role: Third-party report only; company forecasts referred to in prose and report-author forecasts must remain separate. March vocabulary such as 今期 and 来期 is not reassigned to October.

adopted_method_policy.author: Aswath Damodaran
adopted_method_policy.scope: Existing research routing principles. Mapping the two companies below is project adaptation; Damodaran did not classify them in the saved papers.

reported_business_basis.description: Small SAR satellite development/manufacture/operation and data/solution services, investment burden and a future operating-profit transition are described by the report. The satellite-count breakeven statement is the author’s assumption, not an issuer guarantee, adopted threshold or cash breakeven rule.

cases.why_this_route: The business and commercialization/expansion narrative plus operating losses and future profitability pathway support reviewing transition economics and financing. The reason is broader than a single loss year or an information-communications sector label. Company disclosure has not yet confirmed the actual loss cause, present funding or current forecast vintage.
cases.income_scope_boundary: The report separates operating profit from ordinary/net profit because subsidy income is described as non-operating. Positive ordinary/net profit or EPS therefore cannot by itself certify commercial operating profitability, positive operating cashflow, free cashflow or ordinary positive-earnings multiple comparability. The grant receipt/recognition, recurrence and cash timing remain issuer-data questions.

next_public_checks.owner: project research using issuer public disclosures
next_public_checks.check: Obtain latest issuer consolidated statement, explanatory presentation and accounting notes; separate actual/issuer guidance/old Iwai forecast, operating/ordinary/net results and subsidy accounting, period and scope. Confirm what commercial revenue and losses comprise.

next_public_checks.owner: project research using issuer business and results disclosures
next_public_checks.check: Check operational satellite timing, service capacity, contracts to revenue recognition, revenue/margin pathway, fixed/variable operating costs and reinvestment needed for expansion. Do not treat order backlog or satellite count as realized revenue, available cash or a guaranteed operating breakeven threshold.

next_public_checks.owner: project research using issuer cashflow, financing and share-related notes
next_public_checks.check: Check cash, cashflow versus P/L subsidies, capex/development needs, funding commitments/maturity and equity/options/warrants or other dilution. Cash needs, financing capacity, tax losses and survival assumptions remain unset.

next_public_checks.owner: project model review after sourced data
next_public_checks.check: Only then examine a multi-stage DCF with explicitly sourced growth, margins, reinvestment, risk and terminal assumptions. Existing explicit CF arithmetic does not construct these pathways or a survival/dilution model. Assess causes/counterevidence before treating young-loss as confirmed; do not assign survival=1 or a generic failure rate.

not_concluded: Current issuer financial status or latest company forecast
Model adoption from positive EPS or a quoted market PER
A forecast probability, margin, discount rate, terminal value or target price

cases.name_as_reported: MS&ADインシュアランスグループHD

reported_business_basis.description: The report explicitly describes an insurance-group holding company, insurance premium/reinsurance and insurance-claim/financial-market drivers. These business descriptions, rather than memory of an insurance label alone, motivate an equity-focused financial model review.
reported_business_basis.table_note: The annual consolidated table shows operating-profit cells as dashes; those are not zeros or evidence of an operating-loss company. It distinguishes ordinary revenue/profit, net profit, EPS and dividend columns. No table numerical forecasts are newly extracted.

cases.why_this_route: Insurance obligations and financial operations may make ordinary enterprise-debt, working-capital and reinvestment categories unsuitable. The exact liabilities, consolidated versus holding-company scope, insurance accounting, regulatory-capital constraints and distributable equity are not established by this report and require current issuer evidence.
cases.income_scope_boundary: Do not substitute premium volume for a generic corporate revenue input, convert the table’s operating-profit dash to zero, or combine ordinary profit/net income/group adjusted income as if the same economic quantity. Insurance underwriting, claims, reinsurance, investment results and one-offs need an issuer-defined bridge. Higher premiums or a positive net-income figure alone do not establish distributable ordinary shareholder cash.

next_public_checks.owner: project research using issuer financial statements and current capital/solvency disclosures
next_public_checks.check: Obtain latest issuer actual/guidance and accounting notes; identify insurance operating obligations versus financing debt, group/holding/subsidiary scopes, applicable current regulatory-capital/solvency definitions and limits on capital distribution. Do not insert a bank capital ratio into an insurer.

next_public_checks.owner: project research using issuer profit and business-line bridges
next_public_checks.check: Separate net profit from ordinary and adjusted group income, underwriting/claim/reinsurance and investment factors, one-off effects and segment/region mix. Check sustainable earnings, ROE, growth, payout and cost-of-equity comparability before any relative model; retain current periods and equity/share basis.

next_public_checks.owner: project research using issuer capital policy and distributions
next_public_checks.check: Check actual and forecast ordinary-share dividends, buybacks, capital retained for growth, regulatory reinvestment, dilution and group remittances; current payout is not identical to sustainable distributable cash. Merger/savings expectations in the March report are not achieved capital or cashflow.

next_public_checks.owner: project model review after sourced data
next_public_checks.check: Review DDM, regulatory-capital FCFE or equity excess-return families as research alternatives. Existing dividend_discount calculates explicit annual DPS and terminal DPS with explicit costs/growth; it does not generate forecasts or verify sustainable payout. Regulatory-capital FCFE calculator remains unimplemented per existing spec.

cases.relative_model_boundary: Financial PE/PB is allowed by the author. A market PER printed next to the report stock price is not an adopted fair multiple or purchase threshold. Earnings quality, growth, payout, equity cost and business mix must be comparable; no blanket PE prohibition or automatic selection is made.
